steps.label: Baseline
steps.python:
VAL = {'baseline': (12, 10, 18, 110), 'logistic': (21, 12, 9, 108), 'tree': (24, 17, 6, 103)}   # (TP, FP, FN, TN) on 150 validation customers
def metrics(tp, fp, fn, tn):
    p = tp / (tp + fp)
    r = tp / (tp + fn)
    return {'accuracy': (tp + tn) / (tp + fp + fn + tn), 'precision': p, 'recall': r, 'f1': 2 * p * r / (p + r)}
b = metrics(*VAL['baseline'])
print('baseline accuracy', round(b['accuracy'], 2), 'recall', round(b['recall'], 2))
# prints: baseline accuracy 0.81 recall 0.4

steps.label: Compare
Final test
steps.pseudocode: Evaluate once on the test set.
steps.python:
VAL = {'baseline': (12, 10, 18, 110), 'logistic': (21, 12, 9, 108), 'tree': (24, 17, 6, 103)}   # (TP, FP, FN, TN) on 150 validation customers
def metrics(tp, fp, fn, tn):
    p = tp / (tp + fp)
    r = tp / (tp + fn)
    return {'accuracy': (tp + tn) / (tp + fp + fn + tn), 'precision': p, 'recall': r, 'f1': 2 * p * r / (p + r)}
def meets_goal(m):
    return m['recall'] >= 0.75 and m['precision'] >= 0.5
TEST = (22, 19, 6, 103)
val, test = metrics(*VAL['tree']), metrics(*TEST)
print('validation F1', round(val['f1'], 3), ' test F1', round(test['f1'], 3))
print('test precision', round(test['precision'], 3), 'recall', round(test['recall'], 3), 'meets goal:', meets_goal(test))
# prints: validation F1 0.676  test F1 0.638
# prints: test precision 0.537 recall 0.786 meets goal: True

steps.label: Monitor
steps.python:
train_usage, recent_usage, tolerance = 12.0, 9.0, 0.15
shift = (recent_usage - train_usage) / train_usage
print('shift', round(shift, 2), ' investigate:', abs(shift) > tolerance)
# prints: shift -0.25  investigate: True
